newsitem.title: USA: 360 Communications falls on Q4 warning.
newsitem.headline: 360 Communications falls on Q4 warning.

text.p: Shares of 360 Communications Co fell about 10 percent Wednesday, and some analysts said the problems prompting a fourth quarter earnings warning may linger into the current year.
Late Tuesday, 360 Communications, which provides wireless communications, said it plans to take charges in the fourth quarter that will cut earnings by $0.06 to $0.08 a share.
"Bad news like this is rarely a one-quarter phenomenon," said one analyst, who asked not to be named. "Earnings estimates have to be reduced."
XO cited an earnings shortfall from unconsolidated subsidiaries, a one-time federal income tax adjustment and higher-than-projected fraud losses in late December.

Sal Cinquegrani, a spokesman for 360, said the fraud or cloning problems account for about $0.04 of the warning and a tax adjustment for another $0.02. He said an earnings shortfall from unconsolidated subsidiaries could cut 360 earnings by $0.02 a share, or not at all.
"The third piece is really difficult to pinpoint now," Cinquegrani said.

360 did not indicate how much carryover there would be for fraud problems in the current first quarter. Cinquegrani said the company took immediate measures to correct the problems when they were discovered in mid-January. Most problems were found in networks recently acquired.

But analysts said the fraud problems will likely also have a slight effect on the the current first quarter. And the effect from the unconsolidated subsidiaries is unclear, both now and in the long term.
Some analysts said the decline is a chance to buy the stock, citing a strong management team and a company with a better-than-industry record in fraud management.
"I think it's a buying opportunity for cooler heads," said William Vogel, an analyst for Dillon Read, adding he is maintaining his buy rating on the stock.
